name: Standard Loot Pool
description: Regular, Epic and Legendary Loot Boxes. Each box holds four random cosmetics, with at least one Rare or better.
basis: Blizzard describes what a box contains but doesn't publish a list of every eligible cosmetic. Shop collaborations can't come from Loot Boxes.

name: E-Sports Loot Pool
description: Overwatch Esports Loot Boxes, which Blizzard says draw from past esports programs, including Overwatch League team skins.
basis: Blizzard hasn't published a full list, so this shows every esports cosmetic in this site's catalogue. Some of them may not be obtainable from a box.

name: Anniversary Loot Pool
description: Anniversary Loot Boxes from the Anniversary event, including the 10 Year Anniversary Loot Box.
basis: Blizzard hasn't published a full list, so this shows the Anniversary event's cosmetics in this site's catalogue. Some of them may not be obtainable from a box.

sources.title: Reign of Talon: S2 Midcycle Continues the Climb

name: Just For You Pool
description: The personalized section of the shop, which Blizzard has described as tied to the heroes you prefer and the items you equip.
basis: Blizzard doesn't publish which cosmetics can appear here, so no list is shown. Only the game can show your own offers.

sources.title: Overwatch 2 Explained: Battle Pass, Shop, Hero Unlocks, and more
